take_homes: Access and take-up are different numbers. I should ask for the second one on every tool rollout, not just licences issued.

misconception.why: I still think of AI as a licence we buy. But the module made me see that a licence everyone has and nobody uses is a cost with no return, and that take-up has to be built through people's work. It doesn't tell me what that costs, so I'm not convinced yet.

one_line: Good on why rollouts stall, with a useful pre-mortem. But I never got a number I could take to the board.
